for there is no other
remover of this doubt than you.

meaningsEn: The Lord said
"Neither here in this world nor
there in the next is there destruction
for him. For no one who does good ever comes to an evil end."
meaningsTe: The Lord said
"Neither here in this world nor
there in the next is there destruction
for him. For no one who does good ever comes to an evil end."

meaningsEn: He who has fallen away from Yoga is born
again in the house of the pure and prosperous
having attained to the worlds of doers of
good deeds and dwelled there for many long years.
meaningsTe: He who has fallen away from Yoga is born
again in the house of the pure and prosperous
having attained to the worlds of doers of
good deeds and dwelled there for many long years.

meaningsEn: Or he is born
into a family of wise
yogis. But such a birth
in this world is rare.
meaningsTe: Or he is born
into a family of wise
yogis. But such a birth
in this world is rare.

meaningsEn: There
O Arjuna
he regains the disposition of mind that he had in his former body
and from there he strives even more for success in Yoga.
meaningsTe: There
O Arjuna
he regains the disposition of mind that he had in his former body
and from there he strives even more for success in Yoga.

meaningsEn: By the power of his earlier practice, he
is carried forward even against his will. Even
though he is an enquirer about Yoga, he
transcends the Sabda Brahman, i.e., Prakṛti or matter.
meaningsTe: By the power of his earlier practice, he
is carried forward even against his will. Even
though he is an enquirer about Yoga, he
transcends the Sabda Brahman, i.e., Prakṛti or matter.

meaningsEn: But the yogi
striving earnestly
cleansed of all his stains and perfected through many births
reaches the supreme state.
meaningsTe: But the yogi
striving earnestly
cleansed of all his stains and perfected through many births
reaches the supreme state.

meaningsEn: Greater than the ascetics, greater
than those who possess knowledge, greater
than the ritualists is the Yogin.
Therefore, O Arjuna, become a Yogin.
meaningsTe: Greater than the ascetics, greater
than those who possess knowledge, greater
than the ritualists is the Yogin.
Therefore, O Arjuna, become a Yogin.

meaningsEn: He who, with faith, worships Me,
and whose innermost self is fixed
in Me, I consider him to
be the greatest of the Yogins.
meaningsTe: He who, with faith, worships Me,
and whose innermost self is fixed
in Me, I consider him to
be the greatest of the Yogins.

meaningsEn: The Lord said, "With your mind
focused on Me, taking Me as your
support, and practicing yoga—how can you, without
doubt, know Me fully? Hear, O Arjuna."
meaningsTe: The Lord said, "With your mind
focused on Me, taking Me as your
support, and practicing yoga—how can you, without
doubt, know Me fully? Hear, O Arjuna."

meaningsEn: I will declare to you in full this knowledge of God
along with the knowledge
that makes it distinguished
knowing which nothing else remains to be known.
meaningsTe: I will declare to you in full this knowledge of God
along with the knowledge
that makes it distinguished
knowing which nothing else remains to be known.

meaningsEn: Among thousands of men
some strive for perfection; even among those who strive for perfection
only some know Me; and among those who know Me
only some truly know Me.
meaningsTe: Among thousands of men
some strive for perfection; even among those who strive for perfection
only some know Me; and among those who know Me
only some truly know Me.

meaningsEn: Earth, water, fire, air,
ether, Manas, Buddhi, and
the ego sense—thus My Prakriti
is divided into eight parts.
meaningsTe: Earth, water, fire, air,
ether, Manas, Buddhi, and
the ego sense—thus My Prakriti
is divided into eight parts.

meaningsEn: This is My lower Prakṛti. But
O mighty-armed one
know that My higher nature is another. It is the life-principle (Jīva-bhūta)
by which this universe is sustained.
meaningsTe: This is My lower Prakṛti. But
O mighty-armed one
know that My higher nature is another. It is the life-principle (Jīva-bhūta)
by which this universe is sustained.

meaningsEn: Know that all beings have these two
as the source of their birth. Therefore
I am the origin and
the dissolver of the whole universe.
meaningsTe: Know that all beings have these two
as the source of their birth. Therefore
I am the origin and
the dissolver of the whole universe.

meaningsEn: There is nothing higher than Me
O Arjuna. All this
is strung on Me
like rows of gems on a thread.
meaningsTe: There is nothing higher than Me
O Arjuna. All this
is strung on Me
like rows of gems on a thread.

meaningsEn: I am the taste in the waters
O Arjuna! I am the light in the sun and the moon; the sacred
syllable Om in all the Vedas; sound in the ether; and manhood in men
I am.
meaningsTe: I am the taste in the waters
O Arjuna! I am the light in the sun and the moon; the sacred
syllable Om in all the Vedas; sound in the ether; and manhood in men
I am.

meaningsEn: I am the pure scent in the earth; I am the
radiance in the fire; I am
the life force in all beings
and austerity in ascetics.
meaningsTe: I am the pure scent in the earth; I am the
radiance in the fire; I am
the life force in all beings
and austerity in ascetics.

meaningsEn: Know Me
O Arjuna
to be the primeval seed of all beings. I am
the intelligence of the discerning and the brilliance of the brilliant.
meaningsTe: Know Me
O Arjuna
to be the primeval seed of all beings. I am
the intelligence of the discerning and the brilliance of the brilliant.

meaningsEn: In the strong, I am strength,
devoid of desire and passion. In
all beings, I am the desire which
is not contrary to Dharma, O Arjuna.
meaningsTe: In the strong, I am strength,
devoid of desire and passion. In
all beings, I am the desire which
is not contrary to Dharma, O Arjuna.

meaningsEn: Know that all those states of Sattva,
Rajas, and Tamas are from Me
alone; however, I am not in
them; rather, they are in Me.
meaningsTe: Know that all those states of Sattva,
Rajas, and Tamas are from Me
alone; however, I am not in
them; rather, they are in Me.

meaningsEn: The entire universe is deluded by these
three states originating from the Gunas (of Prakrti)
and fails to recognize Me
who am beyond them and immutable.
meaningsTe: The entire universe is deluded by these
three states originating from the Gunas (of Prakrti)
and fails to recognize Me
who am beyond them and immutable.

meaningsEn: (a) For this divine Maya or Mine
consisting of the three Gunas (assumed for purposes of sport)
is hard to overcome. ৷৷ (b) ৷৷ But those who
take refuge in Me alone shall pass beyond the Maya.
meaningsTe: (a) For this divine Maya or Mine
consisting of the three Gunas (assumed for purposes of sport)
is hard to overcome. ৷৷ (b) ৷৷ But those who
take refuge in Me alone shall pass beyond the Maya.

meaningsEn: The evil-doers
the foolish
the lowest of men
those persons deprived of knowledge by delusion (Maya) and those who are dominated by a demoniac nature - they do not seek refuge in Me.
meaningsTe: The evil-doers
the foolish
the lowest of men
those persons deprived of knowledge by delusion (Maya) and those who are dominated by a demoniac nature - they do not seek refuge in Me.

meaningsEn: Four types of men of good deeds worship Me, O Arjuna
the distressed
the seekers of knowledge, the seekers
of wealth, and the men of knowledge
meaningsTe: Four types of men of good deeds worship Me, O Arjuna
the distressed
the seekers of knowledge, the seekers
of wealth, and the men of knowledge

meaningsEn: Of these, the man of knowledge, who is ever
with Me in Yoga and devoted to the One only,
is the foremost; for I am very dear to the
man of knowledge, and he is also dear to Me.
meaningsTe: Of these, the man of knowledge, who is ever
with Me in Yoga and devoted to the One only,
is the foremost; for I am very dear to the
man of knowledge, and he is also dear to Me.

meaningsEn: All these are indeed generous
but I deem the man of knowledge to be My very self; for he
integrated
is devoted solely to Me as the highest end.
meaningsTe: All these are indeed generous
but I deem the man of knowledge to be My very self; for he
integrated
is devoted solely to Me as the highest end.

meaningsEn: At the end of many births
the man of knowledge finds refuge in Me
realizing that 'Vasudeva is all.' It is very
difficult to find such a great souled person.
meaningsTe: At the end of many births
the man of knowledge finds refuge in Me
realizing that 'Vasudeva is all.' It is very
difficult to find such a great souled person.

meaningsEn: Controlled by their inherent nature
and deprived of knowledge by various desires
worldly-minded people resort to other gods
observing various disciplines.
meaningsTe: Controlled by their inherent nature
and deprived of knowledge by various desires
worldly-minded people resort to other gods
observing various disciplines.

meaningsEn: Whichever devotee seeks to
worship with
faith whatever form
I make their faith steadfast.
meaningsTe: Whichever devotee seeks to
worship with
faith whatever form
I make their faith steadfast.

meaningsEn: Endowed with that faith
he worships that form and thereby
gets the objects of his desire
granted in reality by Me alone.
meaningsTe: Endowed with that faith
he worships that form and thereby
gets the objects of his desire
granted in reality by Me alone.

meaningsEn: But the fruit gained by
these men of small understanding is
limited. The worshippers of the gods will go to the gods
but My devotees will come to Me.
meaningsTe: But the fruit gained by
these men of small understanding is
limited. The worshippers of the gods will go to the gods
but My devotees will come to Me.

meaningsEn: Not knowing My higher, immutable, and
unsurpassed nature, the ignorant think of
Me as an entity that has now
become manifest, though I was previously unmanifest.
meaningsTe: Not knowing My higher, immutable, and
unsurpassed nature, the ignorant think of
Me as an entity that has now
become manifest, though I was previously unmanifest.

meaningsEn: Veiled by my Maya
I am not manifest to all; this deluded world
does not recognize me
as the unborn and immutable.
meaningsTe: Veiled by my Maya
I am not manifest to all; this deluded world
does not recognize me
as the unborn and immutable.

meaningsEn: I know all beings, O
Arjuna, past, present, and
those to come; but
no one knows Me.
meaningsTe: I know all beings, O
Arjuna, past, present, and
those to come; but
no one knows Me.

meaningsEn: O Arjuna
all beings are deluded as soon as they are born
due to the delusion of the pairs
of opposites springing from desire and hate.
meaningsTe: O Arjuna
all beings are deluded as soon as they are born
due to the delusion of the pairs
of opposites springing from desire and hate.

meaningsEn: But those who have done good deeds
whose sins have come to an end
are freed from the delusion of the pairs of opposites. They steadfastly worship Me
adhering to their vows.
meaningsTe: But those who have done good deeds
whose sins have come to an end
are freed from the delusion of the pairs of opposites. They steadfastly worship Me
adhering to their vows.

meaningsEn: Those who take refuge in Me and
strive for deliverance from old age and death
know Brahman (or the Self) and all about the nature of that Self
and the entire Karma (or activities leading to rebirth).
meaningsTe: Those who take refuge in Me and
strive for deliverance from old age and death
know Brahman (or the Self) and all about the nature of that Self
and the entire Karma (or activities leading to rebirth).

meaningsEn: And those who know Me with
the Adhibhuta, Adhidaiva, and Adhiyajna, they too,
with their minds fixed in meditation, know
Me even at the hour of death.
meaningsTe: And those who know Me with
the Adhibhuta, Adhidaiva, and Adhiyajna, they too,
with their minds fixed in meditation, know
Me even at the hour of death.

meaningsEn: Person
what is Brahman? What exists in the
individual plane? What is action? What is said
to exist in the physical plane? And what is said to exist in the divine plane?
meaningsTe: Person
what is Brahman? What exists in the
individual plane? What is action? What is said
to exist in the physical plane? And what is said to exist in the divine plane?

meaningsEn: O Madhusudana
how is the entity existing in the sacrifice here in this body
and who is it? And how are You to be
known by people of concentrated minds at the time of death?
meaningsTe: O Madhusudana
how is the entity existing in the sacrifice here in this body
and who is it? And how are You to be
known by people of concentrated minds at the time of death?

meaningsEn: The Blessed Lord said
"The Immutable is the supreme Brahman; selfhood is said to be the entity present in the
individual plane. By action is meant the offerings
that bring about the origin of existence of things."
meaningsTe: The Blessed Lord said
"The Immutable is the supreme Brahman; selfhood is said to be the entity present in the
individual plane. By action is meant the offerings
that bring about the origin of existence of things."

meaningsEn: That which exists in the physical plane is the mutable entity
and what exists in the divine plane is
the Person. O best among the embodied beings
I Myself am the entity that exists in the sacrifice within this body.
meaningsTe: That which exists in the physical plane is the mutable entity
and what exists in the divine plane is
the Person. O best among the embodied beings
I Myself am the entity that exists in the sacrifice within this body.

meaningsEn: And at the time of death
anyone who departs
giving up the body while thinking of Me alone
attains My state; there is no doubt about this.
meaningsTe: And at the time of death
anyone who departs
giving up the body while thinking of Me alone
attains My state; there is no doubt about this.

meaningsEn: O son of Kunti, thinking of any entity,
whichever it may be, one gives up the
body at the end; he attains that very
one, having been always engrossed in its thought.
meaningsTe: O son of Kunti, thinking of any entity,
whichever it may be, one gives up the
body at the end; he attains that very
one, having been always engrossed in its thought.

meaningsEn: Therefore
think of Me at all times and fight; there is
no doubt that by dedicating your mind and intellect to Me
you will attain only Me.
meaningsTe: Therefore
think of Me at all times and fight; there is
no doubt that by dedicating your mind and intellect to Me
you will attain only Me.

meaningsEn: O son of Prtha
by meditating with a mind engaged in the yoga
of practice and not straying away to anything else
one reaches the supreme Person existing in the effulgent region.
meaningsTe: O son of Prtha
by meditating with a mind engaged in the yoga
of practice and not straying away to anything else
one reaches the supreme Person existing in the effulgent region.

meaningsEn: He who meditates on the Omniscient, the Ancient,
the Ruler, subtler than the subtle, the Ordainer
of everything, of inconceivable form, effulgent like the
sun, and beyond darkness—he attains the Supreme Person.
meaningsTe: He who meditates on the Omniscient, the Ancient,
the Ruler, subtler than the subtle, the Ordainer
of everything, of inconceivable form, effulgent like the
sun, and beyond darkness—he attains the Supreme Person.

lines: sa taṁ paraṁ puruṣham upaiti divyam
meaningsEn: At the time of death
having fully fixed the Prana (vital force) between the eyebrows with an unwavering mind
and being imbued with devotion as well as the strength of concentration
he reaches that resplendent Supreme Person.
meaningsTe: At the time of death
having fully fixed the Prana (vital force) between the eyebrows with an unwavering mind
and being imbued with devotion as well as the strength of concentration
he reaches that resplendent Supreme Person.

meaningsEn: I will briefly speak to you of that
immutable Goal, which the knowers of the Vedas
declare; into which diligent ones, free from attachment,
enter, and for which people practice celibacy, aspiring.
meaningsTe: I will briefly speak to you of that
immutable Goal, which the knowers of the Vedas
declare; into which diligent ones, free from attachment,
enter, and for which people practice celibacy, aspiring.

meaningsEn: Having controlled all the senses
confined the mind in the heart
and fixed his own vital force in the head
he should remain steadfast in yoga.
meaningsTe: Having controlled all the senses
confined the mind in the heart
and fixed his own vital force in the head
he should remain steadfast in yoga.

meaningsEn: He who departs, leaving the body
while uttering the single syllable, viz.
"Om," which is Brahman, and thinking
of Me, attains the supreme Goal.
meaningsTe: He who departs, leaving the body
while uttering the single syllable, viz.
"Om," which is Brahman, and thinking
of Me, attains the supreme Goal.

meaningsEn: O son of Prtha
to that yogi of constant concentration and single-minded attention
who remembers Me uninterruptedly and for a long time
I am easy to attain.
meaningsTe: O son of Prtha
to that yogi of constant concentration and single-minded attention
who remembers Me uninterruptedly and for a long time
I am easy to attain.

meaningsEn: As a result of reaching Me
the exalted ones who have attained
the highest perfection do not get birth
which is an abode of sorrows and is impermanent.
meaningsTe: As a result of reaching Me
the exalted ones who have attained
the highest perfection do not get birth
which is an abode of sorrows and is impermanent.

meaningsEn: O Arjuna
all the worlds together with the world of Brahma are subject to return. But
O son of Kunti
there is no rebirth after reaching Me.
meaningsTe: O Arjuna
all the worlds together with the world of Brahma are subject to return. But
O son of Kunti
there is no rebirth after reaching Me.

meaningsEn: Those people who know what day and night are, know the day of Brahma which ends in a
thousand yugas [The four yugas (in the human worlds), viz Satya, Treta, Dwapara, and Kali are made up
of 4,320,000 years. This period multiplied by a thousand constitutes one day of Brahma. His night also extends
over a similar period. See M.S. and V.S.A.], and His night which also ends in a thousand yugas.
meaningsTe: Those people who know what day and night are, know the day of Brahma which ends in a
thousand yugas [The four yugas (in the human worlds), viz Satya, Treta, Dwapara, and Kali are made up
of 4,320,000 years. This period multiplied by a thousand constitutes one day of Brahma. His night also extends
over a similar period. See M.S. and V.S.A.], and His night which also ends in a thousand yugas.

meaningsEn: With the coming of day
all manifested things emerge from the Unmanifest
and when night comes
they merge into that which is called the Unmanifested.
meaningsTe: With the coming of day
all manifested things emerge from the Unmanifest
and when night comes
they merge into that which is called the Unmanifested.

meaningsEn: O son of Prtha
after being born again and again
that very multitude of beings disappears of its own accord at the
approach of night. It comes to life again at the approach of day.
meaningsTe: O son of Prtha
after being born again and again
that very multitude of beings disappears of its own accord at the
approach of night. It comes to life again at the approach of day.

meaningsEn: But distinct from that Unmanifested is the other eternal
unmanifest Reality
who does not get destroyed
when all beings are destroyed.
meaningsTe: But distinct from that Unmanifested is the other eternal
unmanifest Reality
who does not get destroyed
when all beings are destroyed.

meaningsEn: They call Him who has been mentioned as the Unmanifested
the Immutable
the supreme Goal. That is the supreme abode of Mine
from which they do not return once they reach it.
meaningsTe: They call Him who has been mentioned as the Unmanifested
the Immutable
the supreme Goal. That is the supreme abode of Mine
from which they do not return once they reach it.

meaningsEn: O son of Prtha
that supreme Person—in whom all beings are included and by
whom all this is pervaded—is
indeed reached through one pointed devotion.
meaningsTe: O son of Prtha
that supreme Person—in whom all beings are included and by
whom all this is pervaded—is
indeed reached through one pointed devotion.

meaningsEn: O best of the Bharata dynasty
I shall now speak of that time by which
the yogis depart and attain the State of Non return
and also the State of Return.
meaningsTe: O best of the Bharata dynasty
I shall now speak of that time by which
the yogis depart and attain the State of Non return
and also the State of Return.

meaningsEn: Fire, light, daytime, the bright fortnight,
the six months of the northern solstice—by
following this path, persons who are knowers
of Brahman attain Brahman when they die.
meaningsTe: Fire, light, daytime, the bright fortnight,
the six months of the northern solstice—by
following this path, persons who are knowers
of Brahman attain Brahman when they die.

meaningsEn: Following this Path, the yogi, having
reached the lunar light, returns, smoke,
night, as also the dark fortnight and
the six months of the Southern solstice.
meaningsTe: Following this Path, the yogi, having
reached the lunar light, returns, smoke,
night, as also the dark fortnight and
the six months of the Southern solstice.

meaningsEn: These two paths of the world, which are
white and black, are indeed considered eternal. Through
one, a person goes to the state of
non return; through the other, they return again.
meaningsTe: These two paths of the world, which are
white and black, are indeed considered eternal. Through
one, a person goes to the state of
non return; through the other, they return again.

meaningsEn: O son of Prtha
no yogi—one steadfast in meditation—whosoever has known these two courses becomes deluded. Therefore
O Arjuna
be steadfast in yoga at all times.
meaningsTe: O son of Prtha
no yogi—one steadfast in meditation—whosoever has known these two courses becomes deluded. Therefore
O Arjuna
be steadfast in yoga at all times.

meaningsEn: Having known this, the yogi transcends
all the results of righteous deeds
declared in the Vedas, sacrifices, austerities, and
charities, and reaches the primordial, supreme state.
meaningsTe: Having known this, the yogi transcends
all the results of righteous deeds
declared in the Vedas, sacrifices, austerities, and
charities, and reaches the primordial, supreme state.

meaningsEn: The Lord said, "I shall declare to you,
who does not cavil, this most mysterious
knowledge, together with its special knowledge, knowing
which you will be freed from evil."
meaningsTe: The Lord said, "I shall declare to you,
who does not cavil, this most mysterious
knowledge, together with its special knowledge, knowing
which you will be freed from evil."

meaningsEn: This is the royal science, the royal mystery,
the supreme purifier. It is realized through
direct experience, is in accord with Dharma,
is pleasant to practice, and is abiding.
meaningsTe: This is the royal science, the royal mystery,
the supreme purifier. It is realized through
direct experience, is in accord with Dharma,
is pleasant to practice, and is abiding.

meaningsEn: Men devoid of faith in this Dharma
O scorcher of foes
ever remain without attaining Me
on the mortal path of Samsara.
meaningsTe: Men devoid of faith in this Dharma
O scorcher of foes
ever remain without attaining Me
on the mortal path of Samsara.

meaningsEn: This entire universe is pervaded by Me
in an unmanifest form.
All beings abide in Me
but I do not abide in them.
meaningsTe: This entire universe is pervaded by Me
in an unmanifest form.
All beings abide in Me
but I do not abide in them.

meaningsEn: Yet, beings do not remain in Me.
Behold My divine Yoga.
I am the sustainer of all beings, yet I am not in them.
It is My will alone that causes their existence.
meaningsTe: Yet, beings do not remain in Me.
Behold My divine Yoga.
I am the sustainer of all beings, yet I am not in them.
It is My will alone that causes their existence.

meaningsEn: As the powerful element air
moving everywhere
ever remains in the ether
know that so too all beings abide in Me.
meaningsTe: As the powerful element air
moving everywhere
ever remains in the ether
know that so too all beings abide in Me.

meaningsEn: All beings
O Arjuna
enter into My Prakriti at the end of a cycle of time; again
I send them forth at the beginning of a cycle of time.
meaningsTe: All beings
O Arjuna
enter into My Prakriti at the end of a cycle of time; again
I send them forth at the beginning of a cycle of time.

meaningsEn: Controlling the Prakṛti
which is My own
I send forth again and again this multitude of beings
helpless under the sway of Prakṛti.
meaningsTe: Controlling the Prakṛti
which is My own
I send forth again and again this multitude of beings
helpless under the sway of Prakṛti.

meaningsEn: But these actions do not bind Me
O Arjuna
for I remain detached from them
as if I were unconcerned.
meaningsTe: But these actions do not bind Me
O Arjuna
for I remain detached from them
as if I were unconcerned.

meaningsEn: Under My supervision, Prakrti
gives birth to all mobile
and immobile entities, and thus,
O Arjuna, the world revolves.
meaningsTe: Under My supervision, Prakrti
gives birth to all mobile
and immobile entities, and thus,
O Arjuna, the world revolves.

meaningsEn: Fools disregard Me
dwelling in a human form
not knowing My higher nature as
the Supreme Lord of all beings.
meaningsTe: Fools disregard Me
dwelling in a human form
not knowing My higher nature as
the Supreme Lord of all beings.

meaningsEn: Senseless people have a nature that is deluding and similar
to that of rakshasas and asuras. Their hopes are futile
their actions are futile
and their knowledge is futile.
meaningsTe: Senseless people have a nature that is deluding and similar
to that of rakshasas and asuras. Their hopes are futile
their actions are futile
and their knowledge is futile.

meaningsEn: But the great souled ones, O Arjuna,
who are associated with My divine nature,
worship Me with an unwavering mind, knowing Me
to be the immutable source of all beings.
meaningsTe: But the great souled ones, O Arjuna,
who are associated with My divine nature,
worship Me with an unwavering mind, knowing Me
to be the immutable source of all beings.

lines: cha māṁ bhaktyā nitya yuktā upāsate
meaningsEn: Aspiring for eternal communion with Me
they worship Me
always singing My praises
striving with steadfast resolution and bowing down to Me in devotion.
meaningsTe: Aspiring for eternal communion with Me
they worship Me
always singing My praises
striving with steadfast resolution and bowing down to Me in devotion.

meaningsEn: Others
besides offering the sacrifice of knowledge
also worship Me as One
who is characterized by diversity in countless ways and is multiform (in My Cosmic aspect).
meaningsTe: Others
besides offering the sacrifice of knowledge
also worship Me as One
who is characterized by diversity in countless ways and is multiform (in My Cosmic aspect).

meaningsEn: I am Kratu, I am the sacrifice, I
am the offering to the manes, I am the
herb, I am the Mantra, I am the clarified
butter, I am the fire, I am the oblation.
meaningsTe: I am Kratu, I am the sacrifice, I
am the offering to the manes, I am the
herb, I am the Mantra, I am the clarified
butter, I am the fire, I am the oblation.

meaningsEn: I am the father, mother, creator,
and grandfather of the universe; I am
the purifier. I am the syllable Om,
as well as Rk, Saman, and Yajus.
meaningsTe: I am the father, mother, creator,
and grandfather of the universe; I am
the purifier. I am the syllable Om,
as well as Rk, Saman, and Yajus.

meaningsEn: I am the goal, the supporter, the
Lord, the witness, the abode, the refuge, and
the friend. I am the origin, the dissolution,
the basis for preservation, and the imperishable seed.
meaningsTe: I am the goal, the supporter, the
Lord, the witness, the abode, the refuge, and
the friend. I am the origin, the dissolution,
the basis for preservation, and the imperishable seed.

meaningsEn: I give heat
I withhold and send forth the
rain; I am immortality and also death
O Arjuna. I am the being and the non-being.
meaningsTe: I give heat
I withhold and send forth the
rain; I am immortality and also death
O Arjuna. I am the being and the non-being.

meaningsEn: Those who are versed in the three Vedas
having been purified from sin by drinking the Soma juice
pray for passage to heaven and worship Me through sacrifices. Reaching the holy realm of the chief of the gods
they enjoy celestial pleasures in heaven.
meaningsTe: Those who are versed in the three Vedas
having been purified from sin by drinking the Soma juice
pray for passage to heaven and worship Me through sacrifices. Reaching the holy realm of the chief of the gods
they enjoy celestial pleasures in heaven.

meaningsEn: Having enjoyed the spacious world of heaven
they return to the world of mortals
their merit having been exhausted. Thus
those who follow the Vedic rituals and are drawn by desires come and go.
meaningsTe: Having enjoyed the spacious world of heaven
they return to the world of mortals
their merit having been exhausted. Thus
those who follow the Vedic rituals and are drawn by desires come and go.

meaningsEn: Those who, excluding all else, think
of Me and worship Me, aspiring after
eternal union with Me, I look after
their prosperity and welfare (Yoga and Ksema).
meaningsTe: Those who, excluding all else, think
of Me and worship Me, aspiring after
eternal union with Me, I look after
their prosperity and welfare (Yoga and Ksema).

meaningsEn: Even those who are devoted to other divinities with faith in their hearts
worship Me alone
O Arjuna
though not in accordance with the Sastras.
meaningsTe: Even those who are devoted to other divinities with faith in their hearts
worship Me alone
O Arjuna
though not in accordance with the Sastras.

meaningsEn: For
I am the only enjoyer and the only Lord of all
sacrifices. They do not recognize Me in My true nature; hence
they fall.
meaningsTe: For
I am the only enjoyer and the only Lord of all
sacrifices. They do not recognize Me in My true nature; hence
they fall.

meaningsEn: Devotees of gods go to the gods
manes-worshippers go to the manes
worshippers of Bhutas go to the Bhutas
and those who worship Me come to Me.
meaningsTe: Devotees of gods go to the gods
manes-worshippers go to the manes
worshippers of Bhutas go to the Bhutas
and those who worship Me come to Me.

meaningsEn: If one offers Me with love and devotion a leaf
a flower
a fruit or water
I will accept it.
meaningsTe: ఎవరైతే భక్తితో నాకు ఒక ఆకును
ఒక పువ్వును
ఒక పండును లేదా కొంచెం నీటిని సమర్పిస్తారో
ఆ స్వచ్ఛమైన మనస్సు కలవారి భక్తిని నేను స్వీకరిస్తాను.

meaningsEn: Whatever you do, whatever you eat,
whatever you offer, whatever you give
away, whatever austerity you practice, O Arjuna,
do that as an offering to Me.
meaningsTe: Whatever you do, whatever you eat,
whatever you offer, whatever you give
away, whatever austerity you practice, O Arjuna,
do that as an offering to Me.

meaningsEn: Thus equipped in mind with the Yoga of renunciation
you will free yourself from the bonds of Karma
productive of both auspicious and inauspicious fruits. Thus liberated
you will come to Me.
meaningsTe: Thus equipped in mind with the Yoga of renunciation
you will free yourself from the bonds of Karma
productive of both auspicious and inauspicious fruits. Thus liberated
you will come to Me.

meaningsEn: I am the same to all creation; there is none hateful or
dear to me. But those who
worship me with devotion abide in me
and I in them.
meaningsTe: I am the same to all creation; there is none hateful or
dear to me. But those who
worship me with devotion abide in me
and I in them.

meaningsEn: If even the most sinful
man worships Me with undivided devotion
he should be regarded as holy
for he has rightly resolved.
meaningsTe: If even the most sinful
man worships Me with undivided devotion
he should be regarded as holy
for he has rightly resolved.

meaningsEn: Quickly
he becomes righteous and obtains everlasting peace. Affirm on My behalf
O Arjuna
that My devotee never perishes.
meaningsTe: Quickly
he becomes righteous and obtains everlasting peace. Affirm on My behalf
O Arjuna
that My devotee never perishes.

meaningsEn: By taking refuge in
Me, even those of
evil birth, women, Vaisyas, and
Sudras, attain the supreme state.
meaningsTe: By taking refuge in
Me, even those of
evil birth, women, Vaisyas, and
Sudras, attain the supreme state.

meaningsEn: How much more then
for the pure Brahmanas and royal sages who are
My devotees! Having obtained this transient and joyless world
they should worship Me.
meaningsTe: How much more then
for the pure Brahmanas and royal sages who are
My devotees! Having obtained this transient and joyless world
they should worship Me.

meaningsEn: Focus your mind on Me
be My devotee
worship Me. Bow down to Me. Engaging your mind in this manner and regarding Me as the supreme goal
you will come to Me.
meaningsTe: Focus your mind on Me
be My devotee
worship Me. Bow down to Me. Engaging your mind in this manner and regarding Me as the supreme goal
you will come to Me.
